authorization: user approved model review exploratory Pilot
provenance: same assistant two sequential rounds; no human annotators; second pass unannotated shuffled images, not truly blinded

identity groups are within-reference only, not cross-reference motif equivalence
structural negatives annotate visible structure; unknown fine seams can remain
5 review samples and only 2 readable stripe references limit statistical precision
